name: External Cheque Cancellation Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external cheque cancellation reason code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code set published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

CUST.name: Requested By Customer
CUST.definition: Customer requested to stop/cancel the cheque.

DUPL.name: Duplicate
DUPL.definition: Cheque has been issued in duplication of another cheque.

NARR.name: Narrative
NARR.definition: Reason is provided as narrative information in the additional reason information.
